cyprusLifestyle.introP1: Among the many smart home automation solutions, the engineers at Pinout have chosen two that are especially relevant for Cyprus. This is a place where families value the gentle Mediterranean climate and strive for longevity and a healthier lifestyle — quite different from our friends in bustling megacities.
cyprusLifestyle.introP2: The hot climate and relaxed atmosphere of this island, beloved by many Europeans, set a special pace of life, making us all a little less anxious, a bit more carefree...
cyprusLifestyle.subtitleHealth: Taking care of your family's health & living a carefree life on a sunny island
cyprusLifestyle.bodyP1: Building on these features, we've created our first support program for private clients. After reviewing our past developments, exploring dozens of smart home solutions, and testing them in the real-life conditions of Cyprus, we developed an automation system that seamlessly fits your lifestyle.
cyprusLifestyle.bodyP2: It supports your interest in biohacking, ensures ideal conditions for healthy sleep, and helps reduce stress — giving you the ability to check and turn off the air conditioner right from a taxi on your way to a concert of your favorite band.
cyprusLifestyle.footerTagline: Don't become robots — let the robots work for you.

forConstruction.subtitleDevices: How Smart Devices and Cloud Technologies Help Manage Buildings
forConstruction.challengesTitle: Management Companies and the Challenges of Daily Operations
forConstruction.challengesP1: Management companies are responsible for maintaining buildings in a safe and comfortable condition. Full automation of all processes is not yet possible, but today digitalization and IoT solutions can significantly simplify many tasks. For example, smart water and electricity meters allow you to analyze resource consumption and optimize costs. Sensors in engineering systems record deviations from the norm and automatically create requests for diagnostics or repairs, helping to quickly respond to problems.
forConstruction.challengesP2: In many countries, management companies have difficulty providing a full range of services, and those who successfully cope with this task are actively introducing digital technologies into the daily processes of their employees.
forConstruction.challengesP3: Pinout offers one of the newest tools on the market of digital solutions for management companies, and will help establish a direct dialogue between devices and your employees, literally.
forConstruction.cmmsSubtitle: Why? What? how? - the answer to CMMS
forConstruction.cmmsTitle: CMMS – a digital assistant in building management
forConstruction.cmmsP1: For effective management of facility maintenance, CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) are used – specialized systems that allow you to plan work, assign responsible persons, keep records of completed tasks and generate reports.
forConstruction.cmmsP2: Modern CMMS often overlap with ERP and CRM systems, blurring the boundaries between them. However, their key task is to manage physical objects and analyze data from IoT devices. CMMS can be either a standalone solution or an integrated part of a large CRM/ERP platform. Most of these systems are closed solutions that require significant licensing and support costs. In this context, it is worth noting Odoo, which, thanks to its open architecture, can be deployed on the company's own servers, providing autonomy and full control over data.
forConstruction.cmmsP3Bold: Is it possible to make real estate management even more transparent? Yes, if you use a digital twin of the building.
forConstruction.twinTitle: Digital Twin of a Building: Transparency Without Cloud Reliance
forConstruction.twinP1: A digital twin is a virtual copy of a building that displays its current state in real time. It receives data from IoT devices, records the history of maintenance and repairs, providing full control and transparency of facility management.
forConstruction.twinP2Bold: Why are Pinout solutions more profitable?
forConstruction.twinP2: We use open source software and web3 infrastructure, which not only reduces digitalization costs, but also frees your company from dependence on closed solution providers. Customer privacy and partner independence are our priority!
forConstruction.twinImageAlt: Digital Twin of a Building: Transparency Without Cloud Reliance
forConstruction.buildingLi1: A local server based on Home Assistant controls IoT devices, including temperature, humidity, energy consumption, air quality, and others.
forConstruction.buildingLi2: Connect flexibility: Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, LoRaWAN wireless protocols are supported, as well as Modbus, BACnet wired solutions for integration with existing engineering systems.
forConstruction.buildingLi3: Automatic equipment monitoring: Pinout CMMS Report Service records faults, create encrypted reports, transmits them via a p2p network, and updates the digital twin of the building.
forConstruction.mgmtSideTitle:
On the
management company or integrator side:
forConstruction.mgmtLi1: Pinout CMMS Property Management Agent receives reports and automatically creates requests in Odoo.
forConstruction.mgmtLi2: Odoo CRM allows you to manage requests, employee tasks and receive feedback from IoT devices in real time.
forConstruction.testingText: We currently have an MVP that we are testing with our first partners – developers and private clients. We see how modern Internet technologies can change property management, and we already have a long history of using the latest advances in Internet solutions specifically for the tasks of ensuring the privacy and independence of our clients. We invite management companies, integrators and everyone who works with real estate to test our solution and contribute to the development of the new digital era!
forConstruction.cta: Contact us to discuss how this can work for you!

about.terminalText: We've started our journey in 2015 with the first R&D projects in the field of robotics.
about.historyText1: From 2015 to 2023, we participated in more than 20 research and experimental projects in the field of the Internet of Things (IoT), building sensor networks, and designing solutions for smart homes.
about.historyText2: In collaboration with members of our team, scientific articles were published in MIT publications, Frontier Robotics, we won hackathons from BMW, and were selected projects of the year at the largest annual IoT World Congress exhibition in Barcelona.
about.uniqueIotText: In 2023, we created a unique IoT solution for today's smart home market, focused on protecting the privacy of life.
about.smartHomeText: In 2024, the company raised investments for business development, and we are ready to help developers almost anywhere in the world to create futuristic comfortable spaces for living and working.

privacyPolicy.s2Li2: Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent on the site, and interactions

privacyPolicy.s6Intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other European privacy laws, you have the following rights:
privacyPolicy.s6Li1: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold.
privacyPolicy.s6Li3: Deletion: Request data erasure ("right to be forgotten").
privacyPolicy.s6Li4: Objection: Opt-out of tracking and data collection.
privacyPolicy.s6Li5: Data Portability: Request a structured, machine-readable copy of your data.
privacyPolicy.s6Li6: Restriction of Processing: Request a temporary halt to data processing under certain conditions.
privacyPolicy.s6Li7: Lodge a Complaint: File a complaint with a data protection authority if your rights are violated.
